---
type: memory
title: Special Products
---

Match each **product** to its **expanded form**.

| Product | Expanded |
|:--------|:---------|
| $(a + b)(c + d)$ | $ac + ad + bc + bd$ |
| $(a + b)^2$ | $a^2 + 2ab + b^2$ |
| $(a - b)^2$ | $a^2 - 2ab + b^2$ |
| $(a + b)(a - b)$ | $a^2 - b^2$ |

## Hint
A square means the bracket times **itself**: $(a + b)^2 = (a + b)(a + b)$. Then FOIL it.

## Hint
In $(a + b)(a - b)$, the Outer and Inner products are $-ab$ and $+ab$. What happens when you add them?

## Solution
$$
\begin{aligned}
    (a + b)^2 &= a^2 + ab + ab + b^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2 \\
    (a - b)^2 &= a^2 - ab - ab + b^2 = a^2 - 2ab + b^2 \\
    (a + b)(a - b) &= a^2 - ab + ab - b^2 = a^2 - b^2
\end{aligned}
$$

The most common mistake is $(a + b)^2 = a^2 + b^2$. It forgets the two middle terms, $2ab$.
